constraints.constraint: MUST use existing database.auth_db module - DO NOT create new database infrastructure
Token persistence MUST NOT fail authentication - errors should be logged but not propagated
JWT decoding MUST handle non-JWT tokens gracefully (some brokers may not use JWT format)
Token expiry validation MUST be defensive - assume valid if expiry cannot be determined
Dealer account metadata (clientID, isInvestorClient) MUST be stored as JSON in auth_token field
Code reuse priority: 80% of implementation uses existing database functions
Pattern consistency: Follow FivePaisaXTS reference implementation for token rehydration
Backward compatibility: API clients must continue working if token persistence fails

interface.signature: upsert_auth(name, auth_token, broker, feed_token=None, user_id=None, revoke=False) -> int
